name: hitmap
description: Scans a rendered Chromium page for visible, enabled interactive targets whose nine sampled interior points are all intercepted by another pointer-receiving element.
tagline: Measure whether the browser can actually hit the control.
highlights: Uses the rendered browser hit-test stack instead of inferring z-index behavior from source text.
Samples exactly nine interior points and reports only targets with zero reachable sampled points.
Returns ORACLE_UNAVAILABLE when Chromium is missing instead of silently falling back to a weaker judge.
Ships with a frozen historical protocol against three human-fixed interaction failures before any tested-quality claim.
quickstart:
cd skills/ui-ux/hitmap && ./install.sh

hitmap doctor
hitmap scan http://127.0.0.1:4173/ --width 1280 --height 720 --json

permissions.filesystem: reads no target repository files directly; creates and removes a temporary Chromium profile under the operating-system temporary directory
permissions.shell: spawns the user-selected Chromium or Google Chrome executable in headless mode
permissions.network: direct through the launched browser to the exact URL supplied to hitmap scan; no telemetry or other service is contacted by HITMAP
permissions.environment: reads HITMAP_PREFIX during install/uninstall and HITMAP_BROWSER when selecting the browser executable

security.reviewed_by: Not independently reviewed; historical browser protocol remains incomplete as of 2026-08-15.
